subject: Very little aspect to improve in the Search in Files modal window: remember File Masks

messages.author: 865ecb9a4ef46e83
messages.subject: Very little aspect to improve in the Search in Files modal window: remember File Masks
parts:
Hi,

The Search in Files tool is very useful... and most of the times, we use it to search within R files, or any other preferred language or even raw ANSI text files. In any case, we specify a File Mask to avoid scanning files we don't want to search within. Typically, my search mask will be *.R. But for some reason, the File Mask is not stored, contrary to Directory. Consequently, next time I open Tinn-R, the File Mask is always *.*

Could you make Tinn-R remember the File Mask(s) as well? This way, the current (~default) value would be the last value used, and the list would offer the possibility to use some previously used value...

Thanks.


   Marc.
